
I'm wondering if the list of Post-Schism sitters for the Green is correct. My concern is that Rina Hafden -- Elyas Machera's Aes Sedai -- is described as remaining as a sitter after the schism is resolved, but she is not one of the three post-schism sitters listed here. Is the mistake on Rina's page, on this page or a misunderstanding of mine? [[User:Finelinebob|Finelinebob]] ([[User talk:Finelinebob|talk]]) 04:03, November 24, 2014 (UTC)

Having just reread Towers of Midnight, it's quite clear in Ch 27 that the three Greens listed on this page are in fact the Sitters for the Green in the post-schism Hall. As such, the information on Rina Hafden's page must be in error. [[Special:Contributions/107.5.46.255|107.5.46.255]] 06:43, December 16, 2014 (UTC)
